title: 502 Jam Open Mic @ Two Docs Brewing Co.
event_description: A weekly singer-songwriter open mic hosted by Brian Findley at a dog-friendly downtown brewery. Sign-ups open at 4:30 PM and each act plays three or four songs.
event_venue_information:
Two Docs Brewing Co.

Two Docs Brewing Co. is a family-friendly craft brewery at 502 Texas Avenue in downtown Lubbock. The address gives its name to the brewery's much loved Sunday open mic called the 502 Jam which kicks off at exactly 5:02 PM each week. The taproom is inside the Lubbock Cultural District so it sits close to galleries and the historic Depot District music venues.

Atmosphere and Setting

The taproom is relaxed and welcoming with a big outdoor patio that the brewery calls the best dog-friendly patio in West Texas. Dogs are welcome inside and out and kids are welcome too with non-alcoholic craft sodas on the menu. Cornhole and other yard games keep the patio lively and local food trucks park outside so there is always something to eat.

502 Jam Open Mic Night

The 502 Jam is a weekly singer-songwriter open mic on Sundays hosted by Lubbock musician Brian Findley. Performers sign up in person starting at 4:30 PM and the music begins at 5:02 PM. Each act typically gets three or four songs which keeps the list moving and gives plenty of players a turn. The night welcomes original songwriters as well as players who like to bring favorite covers and the crowd is supportive and attentive. The Lubbock Cultural District calendar lists the 502 Jam as a recurring weekly event into 2026.

Beer and Food

Two Docs brews a rotating lineup of house beers from easy drinking lagers and wheat beers to hoppy IPAs and sours. The brewery also offers a membership program with taproom and merchandise discounts. Food trucks rotate through the week so check the brewery's calendar for the lineup.

Other Events

Beyond the open mic the brewery hosts live bands on select nights along with dog-themed events and special beer releases such as sour tastings. It is a popular gathering spot before and after Texas Tech games and downtown festivals.

Good to Know

Two Docs is open Sunday through Thursday from noon to 10:00 PM and Friday and Saturday from noon to midnight. Call (806) 412-4888 or email management@twodocsbrewing.com for event and booking information.

title: Singer-Songwriter Night @ The Blue Light Live
event_description: Lubbock's legendary Monday songwriter night hosted by Jerry Serrano at the room that launched many Texas country careers. Originals only with first come first served sign-up by the stage.
event_venue_information:
The Blue Light Live

The Blue Light Live is one of the most important rooms in Texas country music. It opened in March 1999 inside one of the oldest buildings in downtown Lubbock's historic Depot Entertainment District at 1806 Buddy Holly Avenue. Owners David and Stephanie Brooks took over from founder Tom McDonald in 2005 and have kept the stage focused on developing new artists ever since.

History and Legacy

The Blue Light plays the same role for Lubbock that Antone's plays for Austin. Josh Abbott and Wade Bowen along with William Clark Green and Flatland Cavalry all cut their teeth here and artists such as Randy Rogers and Red Shahan and Dalton Domino and Brandon Adams have strong ties to the room. Wade Bowen has said the Blue Light means everything to him because it is where he learned his craft.

Singer-Songwriter Night

Monday is songwriter night at the Blue Light. The weekly Singer-Songwriter Night starts at 9:00 PM and is hosted by Jerry Serrano. The night is for original songs only so covers are not allowed. Sign-up is first come and first served on a list near the stage. Many performers have moved from a Monday night slot to weekend headline shows so this is a true proving ground for writers of every genre. The venue also runs periodic Singer-Songwriter Competitions.

Sound and Production

The room is known for excellent sound. Its engineers are graduates of the respected sound technology program at South Plains College in nearby Levelland and the venue has modern sound and LED lighting plus on-site recording capability.

Live Music Calendar

The Blue Light presents live music six nights a week with Texas country and Red Dirt and Americana and rock on the bill. Regular performers over the years have included Ryan Bingham and Hayes Carll and Billy Joe Shaver. Covers are typically low early in the week and higher on Friday and Saturday nights.

Good to Know

The Blue Light is a 21 and up venue for most shows with ladies 18 and up welcome on many nights. Doors usually open between 8:00 PM and 9:00 PM and drink specials run until 10:30 PM on most nights. Call (806) 762-1185 or email blbooking@thebluelightlive.com for booking.

title: Open Jam @ Pub 50
event_description: A Tuesday night open jam at a local bar that backs Lubbock musicians seven days a week. Sit in with the house band for country and blues and rock standards.
event_venue_information:
Pub 50

Pub 50 is a locally owned neighborhood bar at 5001 Avenue Q in Lubbock that describes itself as a place that promotes local musicians seven days a week. It is a no-frills and friendly spot where working musicians and music fans rub elbows and where live music fills the calendar nearly every night.

Atmosphere and Setting

Think classic Texas pub with a small stage and a loyal crowd of regulars. The room is casual and unpretentious and the staff knows many guests by name. It is the kind of place where a player can walk in with a guitar and feel at home.

Tuesday Open Jam

The featured event for musicians is the Tuesday night Open Jam from 8:00 PM to midnight. The jam has been led by Billy Cork and 90 Proof and it gives local players a chance to sit in with a solid house band. Expect classic country and blues and rock standards along with plenty of room for pickers and singers to step up. The Lubbock Live Music Scene calendar lists the Open Jam on select Tuesdays in September 2026 so check the bar's Facebook page to confirm each week.

Live Music Calendar

Pub 50 books local musicians throughout the week. Recent listings include Gary Nix on Monday evenings from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM and Owen Franklin with Mike Swafford on Thursday evenings from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Weekends bring full bands and special events.

Karaoke and Games

Karaoke runs on Wednesday nights from 7:30 PM to 11:30 PM and the bar hosts music bingo and other themed nights through the month.

Good to Know

Pub 50 is at 5001 Avenue Q in Lubbock. Call (806) 368-7561 or follow Pub 50 Club on Facebook for the latest schedule.

title: Sunday Night Jam @ Texas Cafe & Bar (The Spoon)
event_description: A late night Sunday jam session featuring local Lubbock musicians at a live music institution open since 1980. Bring your instrument and sit in after the weekend gigs.
event_venue_information:
Texas Cafe & Bar (The Spoon)

Texas Cafe & Bar is a Lubbock institution at 3604 50th Street. It opened in 1980 as the Texas Spoon and became known for smoked barbecue and vibrant live music. The name officially changed to Texas Cafe in the early 1990s but locals still call it The Spoon.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Spoon is a laid-back neighborhood bar and grill with a stage that has hosted local bands for more than four decades. It mixes a sports bar feel on game days with a true live music room at night. The crowd is loyal and friendly and Texas Tech game days are a big deal here.

Sunday Night Jam Session

The venue's Sunday night jam session features the talents of local Lubbock musicians. The Lubbock Live Music Scene calendar lists the Open Mic Jam on Sundays from 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM through September 2026. It is a late night hang where players sit in and trade songs after the weekend gigs are done. Sunday also brings an all-day happy hour.

Live Music Calendar

Live music runs on Wednesday nights at 8:00 PM and on Friday and Saturday nights. Recent bookings include the Owen Franklin Blues Band along with local bands such as Courtney's Company and Element. Thursday nights are karaoke nights from 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

Food and Drink

The kitchen specializes in smoked pit barbecue and pizza. Lunch specials run Wednesday through Friday from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM and a pizza buffet is offered on Wednesdays. Happy hour runs daily with times that vary by day.

Good to Know

Texas Cafe & Bar is at 3604 50th Street in Lubbock. Call (806) 792-8544 or email macy.txcafe@gmail.com and follow @txcafethespoon on social media for events.

title: Open Mic @ The Escondido Grill
event_description: An early evening acoustic open mic at a hidden Southern restaurant with a pond-side patio and roaming peacocks. Ideal for singer-songwriters and duos.
event_venue_information:
The Escondido Grill

The Escondido Grill is a Southern restaurant tucked away on Spirit Ranch at 701 Regis Street in Lubbock. Escondido means hidden in Spanish and the name fits a property shaded by century-old elm and oak and cypress trees. It is one of the most scenic places in the city to hear acoustic music over dinner.

Atmosphere and Setting

Guests can dine indoors or on an outdoor patio that looks over a peaceful pond and landscaped grounds. Peacocks roam the property and guests can even feed them. Reviewers describe easy live music in the evening and a calm ambiance that feels far from the city.

Open Mic

The Escondido Grill hosts an open mic on Tuesday and Wednesday evenings from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM according to the Lubbock Live Music Scene calendar for September 2026. It is a relaxed early evening slot that suits acoustic singer-songwriters and duos who want a friendly dinner crowd. Sign-up is in person so arrive a little early and confirm with the restaurant before you go.

Live Music Calendar

Beyond the open mic the restaurant books local acoustic artists for evening sets throughout the week. The pairing of patio seating and live music makes it a popular date night spot.

Food and Drink

The menu features Southern cuisine and smokehouse favorites along with burgers and more. The restaurant also offers catering and private parties and online reservations.

Good to Know

The Escondido Grill is open Tuesday through Thursday from 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM and Friday and Saturday from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Call (806) 762-6201 or email info@escondidogrill.com.
